title: MJ Lenderman: The Artist
description: North Carolina's wry, wobbly-guitar songwriter: where he's from, the band he played in and the records. A small starter set, so add your questions and it will grow.

cards.prompt: Which North Carolina mountain city is MJ Lenderman from?
cards.details: Asheville's small, close-knit music scene shaped both his solo work and his band.

cards.prompt: MJ Lenderman played lead guitar in which Asheville band?
cards.details: A noisy, country-tinged indie rock band. His lead guitar is a big part of their sound.

cards.prompt: Who is the singer and songwriter who leads the band Wednesday?
cards.details: She and Lenderman were long-time collaborators. Their songs share a love of small-town Southern detail.

cards.prompt: MJ Lenderman's music is often described as a mix of indie rock and which other genre?
cards.details: Think slacker guitar plus pedal steel, and dryly funny lyrics.
The record that started getting him noticed well beyond North Carolina.

cards.prompt: The Boat Songs track "Hangover Game" references which basketball legend?
cards.details: A nod to the famous story of Jordan playing through illness (or, the joke goes, a hangover). Lenderman loves sports references.

cards.prompt: What is MJ Lenderman's 2024 breakthrough album?
cards.details: Widely praised as one of the year's best albums, full of funny, sad portraits of hapless men.
A label known for idiosyncratic songwriters.

cards.prompt: "She's Leaving You" is a single from which MJ Lenderman album?
cards.details: A wry break-up song with a big, ragged guitar sound.
